items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: Carmen pulled me in on a project in L.A... Carmen said, 'hey, I know this bass player guy, I’ll bring him with me.' ... Carmen had heard a couple of my original tunes and he says, 'why don’t you play these for the guys?' So I played three songs of mine. ... We went in and cut three songs.

ctx.x: The flight went down outside of Buffalo. But we had great bands. And I finally, after hearing this guy on record and hearing about him from Carmen and Ricky, I finally got to meet Don Alias. Because Don was in the band. And Don and I became fast friends, I think mostly because I knew Ricky and Carmen. And boy, talk about, as Corey Allen, our keyboardist said one time, he says, “Don just flies at a different altitude.” And it was true. We would play, we always did “Amazing Grace.” And Don was just playing some…
Yeah. That was a shock. Well talk about your songwriting a bit. How do you start?
